message: XVatsim 2.2.0 is available. Download the complete package once from X-Plane.org or GitHub Releases and use the new Manager included with it.
release_notes: Improves Brain-owned controller selection with independent evidence and route-relevant departure and arrival terminal polygon stacks.
Adds regional CTAF and UNICOM Standby Assist sequencing, including UNICOM 122.800 during Enroute when no eligible controller is online.
Broadens electrical-state detection for battery, GPU, APU, and generator transitions on standard and custom aircraft.
Bounds diagnostic-file growth and avoids unrelated worldwide terminal-controller processing.
Adds a new Manager that can securely retrieve and verify future compatible XVatsim update payloads.
